component.name: Voxxa
component.summary: Voice-driven slide control for worship services

description.p: Voxxa listens to the band, recognises which song is being sung against a loaded setlist, and automatically advances the worship slides on ProPresenter, FreeShow, OpenLP, OpenSong, Proclaim, PowerPoint, or anything else that takes keyboard input. All audio stays on the local machine — no cloud, no telemetry.

ul.li: Ten import formats including Planning Center pull and Hymnary.org search
Stage Display companion window for confidence monitors
Local HTTP API for Stream Deck / foot pedals / Companion / QLab
Zero outbound network calls by default — proven by a live counter
